chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Vaudeville at Loew's State and a Benny Goodman concert in Boston
summary: She played vaudeville houses repeatedly and was an added attraction with Goodman in Boston, carrying her own arrangements from Columbia.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit

blocks.x: Okay, so that takes us away from the Onyx Club period. And now you entered a phase of your career where you were on the road quite a bit.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yes, I did vaudeville. I used to be in Loew's State at least four times a year. And I was on a theater tour, more or less. You know, I was booked out of New York and I guess I must have been out on the road about two years doing vaudeville theaters. You know, jumping from one place to another. And, well vaudeville was still in. And so this gave me quite a broad experience of working with other musicians. I was always the featured attraction. And they were also having bands on the stage at the time. So I worked with different groups. I worked vaudevilles with Bunny Berigan at Loew's State. I worked with Glen Gray's orchestra. I worked with Johnny Long, Henry Busse, and whatever.
I also see in my notes here. I have Benny Goodman's name down. Did you work with him as a single somewhere along the line?

I did a concert with Benny Goodman up in Boston, Massachusetts. It was a broadcast when he had the Chesterfield Show. And I worked up there with him for a week and then I remember having went with Benny up in Canada on some of the concert tours he did up there, Montreal, Toronto.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
No, I just went up there as an added attraction.
Did the band accompany you when you sang?
I carried my own arrangements along with me, my musical arrangements with me. And whatever band was there, that was the band that played for me.
You had big band arrangements or they were Kirby style?
